mapper.sql: id AS payment_id, member_id, subscription_id, payment_key, order_id, order_name, status, method, total_amount, requested_at, approved_at, canceled_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment ( member_id, subscription_id, payment_key, order_id, order_name, status, method, total_amount, requested_at, approved_at, canceled_at) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{subscriptionId}, #{paymentKey}, #{orderId}, #{orderName}, #{status}, #{method}, #{totalAmount}, #{requestedAt}, #{approvedAt}, #{canceledAt})
mapper.select: SELECT approved_at FROM payment WHERE subscription_id = #{subscriptionId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
